lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor: lacks a defined list of Representatives, whereas Al Noor allows sharing with employees, professional advisers, and subcontractors.
Worse for AtliQ than Meridian: expands the definition of Confidential Information to include all analyses and notes prepared by AtliQ.
Worse for AtliQ than Harrington: defines protected information as one-way from the Company instead of being mutual for both parties.
Better for AtliQ than Trustline: removes the restriction to store data only in India while keeping the same six-hour incident reporting timeframe.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack: requires reporting of a personal data incident within six hours rather than twenty-four hours.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor: imposes a strict six-hour deadline for reporting data incidents which was not previously required.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor: adds a 24-month non-solicitation restriction and removes the geographic limitation to the GCC region.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit: adds a 24-month non-solicitation restriction and removes the geographic limitation to India.
Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan: extends the non-compete 12 months post-termination and adds a 24-month non-solicitation clause.
